title: Tax break for affordable housing at Gowanus Green, Brooklyn
summary: The Council would approve a real property tax exemption for the Gowanus Green Site A affordable housing project at Block 471, Lot 1 in Brooklyn, under Section 577 of the Private Housing Finance Law. The exemption would run for up to 40 years from an effective date tied to the property's conveyance to a housing development fund company and could end early if the project is not built or operated as required. It applies only to a building that gets a certificate of occupancy within five years of that effective date.
